# MauQuota 2.1.0

## Customizable appearance

- Added a native appearance settings window with macOS color wells and the system color picker.
- Added independent custom colors for the 5-hour ring, weekly ring, 5-hour menu-bar percentage, weekly menu-bar percentage, 5-hour detail text, and weekly detail text.
- Each custom color can be enabled or reset independently. Changes apply immediately without a network request.
- Preserved threshold-based ring and number colors and system label colors as the defaults.

## Plus and Pro quota presentation

- Plus accounts continue to show confirmed 5-hour and weekly windows.
- Pro 100, Pro 200 and Pro 500 accounts show the weekly allowance only; the 5-hour window is not part of these plans' current Codex allowance.
- The menu-bar icon omits the inner ring when no 5-hour window exists instead of drawing a misleading empty track.
- Tooltips and account labels reflect the recognized plan and available quota windows.
- Unknown plans continue to follow confirmed server-returned windows; missing windows are never treated as unlimited.

## Validation

- Added parser tests for Plus, Pro, Pro 100 / 200 / 500 and weekly-only responses.
- Added persistence, normalization and reset tests for custom colors.
- No third-party UI or color-picker dependency was added.
